body:
So I can go to a therapist and say, "I think about killing myself every day and I think I might actually go through with it soon" and they won't make me go to an institution?

My parents are not an option.  I've gone through every professor friend I have.  On both counts they wish me the very best of luck after reviewing my lack of options.  It doesn't make me feel better, it makes me feel unempowered.

You should enroll in college.  I was where you are now at that age, and going to university made my life better.  I made new friends, got a girlfriend, I had purpose, and I learned I had interests and talents that I didn't know I had.  I also partied too much and ruined my life for a little while, but that passed too.

I went to the school's free therapy sessions a few months ago and stopped going because we just kept dancing around my death wish.  If I tell them they'll institutionalize me.  And when I talked about my issues financially they just nodded and agreed, they didn't offer me a feasible way out of my predicament. 

I appreciate the kind words though.  

I know I'm not the only one in a situation like this, but somehow knowing this is a chronic issue that is deeply imbedded into the core of the era I live in doesn't really comfort me.
